name: 茶盏
subject: One stout celadon tea bowl, open dark amber tea surface, pale green thick rim, squat dark green foot. Simple wide bowl silhouette, 3 green tones and 2 tea tones. No handle. NO decoration, cracks, speckles, reflection lines, or tiny patterns.

name: 竹笛
subject: One thick diagonal honey-yellow bamboo flute. Four large dark square finger holes, two wide brown node bands, a very short red thread at bottom. Open dark mouthpiece. Simple coarse stepped straight edges, not a shiny golden instrument. No thin strings or engravings.

name: 战马铃
subject: One squat bronze harness bell hanging from a short thick brown leather strap. Broad flared skirt, dark opening and single chunky gold clapper, one green patina block. Only three bronze shades. No carvings, inscriptions, tiny rivets, or fine surface texture.

name: 鼓槌
subject: One stout diagonal wooden drum mallet. Squared oxblood red padded head, two broad cream binding strips, short brown handle with a tiny dark wrist loop. Large simple pixel clusters, plain matte surfaces. Not an oversized fantasy hammer. No stitching or grain lines.

name: 明月佩
subject: One thick pale silver crescent pendant, large open crescent cutout, navy cord loop at top and one small square blue bead below. Three silver shades. Strong angular moon silhouette, plain surface. No surface cracks, scattered highlights, twisted chain detail or glow.

name: 补子官徽
subject: One square dark navy cloth official rank badge with a plain ochre border. Inside, an extremely simplified cream crane bird made from about 12 LARGE square pixel clusters above TWO broad teal wave steps. Straight square cloth edges, one tiny folded corner. No feather detail, no fine embroidery, no ornamental border, no text.

name: 星斗盘
subject: One thick small bronze star dial in slightly tilted frontal view. Dark navy face, SEVEN large pale yellow square dots in a Big Dipper path connected by a simple ochre line. Small short sighting tab on upper right, squat bronze rim only two pixels thick in logical design. No concentric circles, tick marks, extra stars, complex perspective, engraving or glints.

name: 香囊
subject: One squat indigo cloth sachet with a wide folded mouth, thick ochre cord knot and two broad tan dried herb tips peeking out. Only three blue shades and one small gold square stitch patch. Simple angular cloth folds, no woven texture, fine tassels, embroidery or outlining every fold.

name: 朱砂囊
subject: One squat dull red cinnabar cloth pouch with gathered top, thick dark red tie and a plain cream square patch bearing one vermilion pigment block. Broad angular folded body. Three flat red shades, no scattered grains, cloth weave, stitching, tiny wrinkles or decorative tassels.

name: 龙王逆鳞
subject: One single heavy dark teal dragon reverse scale. Broad angular shoulders, long tapered tip and one raised lighter teal center ridge, one large chipped pale edge patch. Three teal colors plus dark outline and pale chip. No layered tiny scales, veins, noise or glossy highlights. Organic armor scale, not a shield.

name: 海螺
subject: One chunky ivory sea conch shell diagonally facing right, three broad stepped spiral whorls, large dark coral opening and short pointed end. Three cream tones and two dark coral tones. Simple stepped Minecraft inventory silhouette. No ribs, speckles, ridges, pearly gloss or dozens of tiny highlight pixels.

name: 战鼓坠
subject: One squat red wooden war drum charm, broad cream oval drumhead, dark red body, just TWO thick brown diagonal rope bands, small leather hanging loop. Three cream shades, two red shades. Chunky compact pixel silhouette. No grain, mottling, stitching, many rope lines or gold ornamental studs.
